build: Azure Core and Entropy are two of the 52.4% winning core; Overseer, the third, never made the build.
Megacosm deals max-health damage over time on ability hits, plus bonus-health damage over time on heroes.
Caustica, finished last, ignores part of magical armor; fights before the purchase ran without Caustica.
eternal: Xyris adds bonus damage growing with units killed; Dominance heals on takedowns and Cull the Weak hits minions and monsters harder.
Lotus clearly leads this mid Eternal field; Xyris ranks behind Demiurge and Aion.

Eureka! clearly leads this mid augment field; Blast Zone ranks third, behind Auto-Lock Amp.
crest: Soulbearer's Anima active shields and adds magical lifesteal plus movement speed briefly.
Soulbearer clearly leads this mid crest field. Sound keep.

Soulbinder and Combustion complete the 55.5% core beside the Wraith Leggings already built.
Eureka! over Blast Zone is the field-backed swap: an extra level from FDA stacks instead of the wider mine.

Hoarfrost roots inside a lingering frost ring; Cryoseism slows, then stuns, then explodes around the target.
Legion added four more kills here; Rally Point's standard knocks enemies back.
build: Alternata, the evolved Alternator, and Earthshaker match two of the 65.2% core; Nightfall never made the build.
Salvation met the tenacity need set by the enemy hard-CC count; Absolution met the magical-armor need against Aurora.
The Perforator, finished last, arrived after most fights.
eternal: Vesh deals extra damage over time after ability hits on heroes; Lich adds magical lifesteal, Mind Rot current-health damage.
Knell clearly leads this offlane Eternal field; Vesh ranks well behind, and Lich with Mind Rot is the best Vesh pair.
augment: Volcaic Slam leaves a rupture behind empowered Cindara that erupts for damage and a slow.
Volcaic Slam clearly leads this offlane augment field. Sound keep.
crest: Judgement's Thunder Cleaver active damages an area and heals per hero hit, weaker after the first hit.
Brutallax and Gravitum lead a toss-up in this offlane crest field; Judgement, the most played, ranks well behind.
improvement: Tainted Blade, a flagged need left unbuilt, cuts Legion's healing on physical damage.
A physical-armor item answers Legion's damage at the cost of offense; Legion's penetration left this offlane an estimated 20 armor.
Knell over Vesh is the field-backed swap: armor shred on both armor types, giving up Vesh's damage over time.

eternal: Vesh adds a damage-over-time echo to ability hits on heroes; The Tenth Seal and Millennia raise ultimate damage.

matchup: Kwang was the jungle opponent: two kills on this jungler, with a Kwang death in return late.
Surge of the Heavens knocks up and stuns when Kwang dashes into the thrown Blade; commit after Kwang spends Surge.
Legion and Argus scored two kills apiece on this jungler; Steel scored the remaining kill.

Draconum heals on takedowns and adds physical armor; Void Helm adds magical armor and boosts all healing received.
Basilisk shreds physical armor on hero damage but came last, after most fights.
eternal: Lotus grants a random damage, haste, speed or health gain periodically and on takedowns; Early Bloom adds a level.
Lotus leans first in this jungle Eternal field. Sound keep; Early Bloom with Prima Donna is the best Lotus pair.
augment: Jungle Invasion adds physical power inside the jungle, doubled in the enemy jungle.
Jungle Invasion leads a toss-up with Feral Ambush in this jungle augment field. Sound keep.
crest: Judgement's area slash heals on the first hero hit, then at half effect on later hits.
Pacifier leans first in this jungle crest field; Judgement ranks well behind.

Anti-heal through Tainted Blade was the other unmet need, against Legion's healing.
Prima Donna over Immaculate matches the best Lotus pair: more damage dealt to heroes, more damage taken.

threats: Chain-CC risk (1 hard-CC abilities, ~0.5s of lockdown): Kwang Surge of the Heavens (knockup 0.5s). Don't group tight into it — stagger the engage and hold mobility/cleanse for the key one.
Heal-stacking: Steel. Anti-heal is mandatory against this comp — we brought none.
Enemy is 4/5 magical — one magic-resist item goes a long way.
synergy: Our engage/CC: Gadget Security Gate (root 1s). Our kills come from landing burst INSIDE that CC window — whoever lands it, the rest must follow up immediately.
We have sustain (Maco) — favor the longer fight where our heals out-grind them.
Strong AoE/teamfight kit — group at choke points and fight on top of objectives.

ourKits.combo: Security Gate roots, Sticky Mine is empowered by a basic attack, Seek and Destroy follows the target, then Tesla Dome traps the fight
ourKits.winCondition: root with the gate and hold enemies inside the Tesla Dome while it shreds magical armor
ourKits.passive: FDA stacks from kills, ability hits and takedowns permanently grant magical power
ourKits.playWith: frontline that holds enemies inside the Dome
ourKits.playAgainst: do not walk through Security Gate; leave Tesla Dome early since it grows larger; with no mobility in the kit, dive Gadget after the gate is used; magic armor helps

ourKits.combo: First Intent dash in for a shield, Ashen Vow outer edge to slow and empower Cindara, Swan Song to restrain the target and set her blade Ablaze, then Minueta stabs to execute.
ourKits.winCondition: Land Swan Song on a key target to restrain them and spend the Ablaze window with longer range and more power, finishing with Minueta.
ourKits.passive: Last Light: she uses Energy instead of Mana, restores Energy on takedowns, and turns bonus mana into physical power.
ourKits.playWith: Engage or CC teammates who group enemies for Ashen Vow and help her reach the restrained target.
ourKits.playAgainst: Ashen Vow has a short channel and its slow is on the outer edge, so step inside or away. She is Unstoppable during Swan Song, so save CC for after it; fight her after First Intent's shield is spent. Armor answers her physical damage.

ourKits.combo: Maco Fly! to slow and shield himself, Maco Sparkle! from range for a longer stun, Maco Gift! to heal allies or damage enemies, then a fully charged Maco Strike!
ourKits.winCondition: Land long-distance Sparkle! stuns and charged Strike! pushes while healing and speeding up allies with Gift!
ourKits.passive: Mach Speed! builds movement speed while moving and grants slow immunity at full stacks, lost when hit by heroes.
ourKits.playWith: A roaming, pick-oriented team that can follow his stuns.
ourKits.playAgainst: Hit him to remove Mach Speed! stacks. Maco Sparkle! is slow-moving and stuns longest at range, so sidestep it or close the distance; dodge the charged Strike! line.

ourKits.combo: Mercy for 3 Vengeance stacks, Dusk to purify for burst and slow, Shadow Glide to reposition, then Purge while gliding as needed.
ourKits.winCondition: Stack Vengeance with basics and abilities, then shred the team with Purge and reset Dusk and Shadow Glide on kills.
ourKits.passive: Nevermore periodically makes her next basic or Mercy fire a Raven that deals current-health damage in a small area.
ourKits.playWith: Peel that keeps divers off her while she channels Purge.
ourKits.playAgainst: During Purge she cannot attack or cast anything but Shadow Glide and is slowed, so CC her then. Avoid feeding takedowns since they reset Shadow Glide, and expect Purge's anti-heal.

ourKits.combo: Ambush leap and slow, Unleash for maximum attack speed cleaving basics, Cull to lock the target, Invigorate to cleanse and heal.
ourKits.winCondition: Stick to one target, build Rage for regen and faster cooldowns, and out-sustain them in long fights.
ourKits.passive: Ancestral Fury builds Rage on hits, giving health regen and faster cooldowns, plus movement speed at high Rage.
ourKits.playAgainst: Buy anti-heal to cut Invigorate and Rage regen. Save your CC until after Invigorate is used since it cleanses, and break off for a few seconds so his Rage decays.

enemyKits.combo: Judgement of the Heavens to tether, Surge of the Heavens into the Blade to knock up and stun, Light of the Heavens for true damage at the Blade, Fury of the Heavens to teleport and slow.
enemyKits.winCondition: Tether a target with the Blade, knock them up by dashing into it, and brawl with Energized basics that cut his cooldowns.
enemyKits.passive: Strike of the Heavens Energizes his basics after ability hits, adding attack speed, lightning damage and cooldown reduction.
enemyKits.playWith: Follow-up damage while he tethers and knocks up.
enemyKits.playAgainst: Watch where the Blade lands: it tethers, Surge into it knocks up, and Fury teleports him to it. Move away from the Blade and fight after Surge is used.

enemyKits.combo: Ether Crystal pushes then implodes to pull enemies together, Dread Nova stuns the group, Particle Shredder homes in, then Synaptic Obliterator beams finish low targets
enemyKits.winCondition: poke from long range, zone with Ether Crystal and land Dread Nova stuns into Obliterator beams
enemyKits.passive: abilities apply Disintegration stacks that make further ability hits deal more damage
enemyKits.playWith: a frontline to protect him while he channels Synaptic Obliterator
enemyKits.playAgainst: dodge Dread Nova, his only stun; dive him during the Synaptic Obliterator channel when he is immobile, and keep health high since beams hit harder on missing health; magic armor blunts his damage

enemyKits.combo: Bull Rush in unstoppable to knock back → Shield Bash stun → Shield Slam knockup and stun, Force Shield to block projectiles
enemyKits.winCondition: engage with Shield Slam or Bull Rush and protect carries with Force Shield's projectile wall
enemyKits.passive: a self-shield that lasts until broken and refreshes when out of damage, plus hybrid armor
enemyKits.playWith: ranged carries he can shield from enemy projectiles, and follow-up damage for his engages
enemyKits.playAgainst: Bull Rush is unstoppable, so do not waste CC into it; walk around Force Shield instead of shooting into it, and fight after Shield Slam is on cooldown

enemyKits.combo: Saturation Charge mines to slow, Frag Order to launch enemies, Orbital Sanction to track them, Rally Point to knock back divers and heal allies.
enemyKits.winCondition: Hold an area with Orbital Sanction and mines while Rally Point keeps his team healthy and his rifle on infinite ammo.
enemyKits.passive: Ballistic Calibration turns bonus attack speed into ability haste and unlocks ability upgrades at item stat thresholds.
enemyKits.playWith: Frontliners who fight inside Rally Point's heal and hold enemies in the Orbital beam.
enemyKits.playAgainst: Stun him while he cooks Frag Order to make him drop it. Bait Rally Point's knockback before engaging, trade when he reloads, and buy anti-heal against Rally Point's heal and armor against his physical damage.

enemyKits.combo: Glacial Charge dashes in, Boreal Sweep slows, Hoarfrost roots enemies that touch the ring, then Cryoseism slows and stuns a target before it explodes
enemyKits.winCondition: chain slow, root and stun to lock fights down while her Frost Storm grinds max-health damage
enemyKits.passive: jumping mid-air leaps her and leaves a Replica that draws tower aggro; hitting a Hero or Monster 4 times summons a Frost Storm
enemyKits.playWith: burst damage that turns her long CC chain into kills
enemyKits.playAgainst: do not walk into the Hoarfrost ring while it persists; Cryoseism slows before it stuns, so cleanse or tenacity help, and spread so the explosion does not chain; she is weak once Glacial Charge is down

lines: Lead story: Damage well above normal. 2,109 hero damage a minute, more than 98% of Gadget mid players this patch (41% of the team's). The damage came from Entropy, Megacosm, Wraith Leggings.
Tesla Dome at rank 3: 95s base, about 66.4s by the end (30% shorter) from 43 ability haste: Azure Core 10, Entropy 15, Megacosm 10, Soulbearer 8.
17 takedowns (13 kills, 4 assists) fed: Dominance (minor), Field Data Accumulation (passive).
Gadget dealt 84,346 hero damage, 41% of their team's, with +530 magical power from items.

Penetration: Wraith Leggings 11, Caustica ignores 35%; against Argus (level 18: about 49 magical armor, 21 after penetration; took 18,118 magical damage from heroes, 64% of all hero damage they took) and Legion (level 18: about 47 magical armor, 20 after penetration; took 14,515 magical damage from heroes, 53% of all hero damage they took) that is about 23% and 23% more damage (estimate: percent penetration taken before flat).
Entropy (item): On dealing Ability Damage: Deal 3 (+3.5%) additional Damage. Each Ability can only trigger this effect once every 0.2s, per Target.
Megacosm (item): On dealing Ability Damage: Deal 2.5% of Target's Max Health as Damage over 3s. Additional applications refresh the duration.
Megacosm (item): On dealing Ability Damage to Heroes: Deal 6% of Target's Bonus Health as Damage over 3s.
Wraith Leggings (item): Against Heroes below 40% Health: Abilities deal 12% bonus Magical Damage.
Caustica (item): On dealing Ability Damage to a Hero: While they are above 50% Health. For every point of Bonus Magical Armor they possess. Deal 0.2% more Damage.
Xyris (Eternal): Deal 3% bonus damage, increased by 0.4% per 10 units killed, up to 400 units.
Cull the Weak (Eternal minor): Deal 7% bonus damage to Minions and Monsters, and restore 1% Missing Mana on unit kill.

Sustain: Azure Core: On going below 40% Health: Gain a 100 (+12%) Shield for 5s.; Soulbearer: Gain a 100 (+35) (+6%) Shield for 8s. Gain 20% Magical Lifesteal and 10% Movement Speed for 8s.; Dominance: Takedowns heal you for 100 (+15% Missing Health).; 6,102 healing recorded.
Toughness: +250 health; took 40,973 damage, mitigated 26,996, died 6 times.

Lesson: Gadget's penetration cut through: Argus took about 23% more magical damage than their armor alone allows (estimate: at level 18 their armor was about 49, about 21 after 11 flat + 35% penetration).

(changes Sticky Mine, 5.6s cooldown with their haste) Field: 47.8% in 6329 games, 30% of picks, below the hero-role's 50%.

Loadout minor Dominance: Every takedown heals Gadget, more when low on health. Lets Gadget keep fighting after a kill instead of backing off. (game text: Takedowns heal you for 100 (+15% Missing Health).) Field: 50.6% in 561 games, 80% of picks, level the hero-role's 50%.

Loadout minor Cull the Weak: Cull the Weak adds 7% damage against minions and monsters and refunds 1% of missing mana per unit kill, so Seek and Destroy and Sticky Mine clear waves and camps faster and cheaper. No effect against heroes. (game text: Deal 7% bonus damage to Minions and Monsters, and restore 1% Missing Mana on unit kill.) Field: 52.5% in 377 games, 54% of picks, above the hero-role's 50%.

Loadout crest Soulbearer: Activate for a shield, healing off magic damage and a bit of speed. Use it as Tesla Dome starts so its long damage window heals Gadget. (game text: Anima:  Gain a 100 (+35) (+6%) Shield for 8s. Gain 20% Magical Lifesteal and 10% Movement Speed for 8s.) Field: 53.6% in 2761 games, 13% of picks, above the hero-role's 50%.

Stack (Kept alive in fights): 5 effects on one trigger: Azure Core, Megacosm, Caustica, Soulbearer, Dominance. Together they made staying in a long fight cheaper: more armor, shields or healing the longer it went.

Stack (Every ability hit set off): 4 effects on one trigger: Entropy, Megacosm, Wraith Leggings, Caustica. Gadget has 4 damaging abilities (Seek and Destroy, Sticky Mine, Tesla Dome hit an area, so one cast sets them off on several heroes), and 43 ability haste brought them back 30% sooner: more casts, more triggers.
Stack (Finishing damage on low-health targets): 2 effects on one trigger: Azure Core, Wraith Leggings. Once a fight started going their way, these finished it.
Stack (Healing off the damage): 2 effects on one trigger: Soulbearer, Dominance.

The Eternal was part of it: Xyris (Dominance + Cull the Weak) sits on the same triggers as the items (kept alive in fights; healing off the damage), so every extra second in a fight made them harder to kill.
Countered? 1 of the 5 players Gadget killed built magical armor (Steel). Anti-heal on Kwang. We killed Gadget 6 times.
Copy it? Xyris (Dominance + Cull the Weak): 56% in 273 Gadget midlane games, above the hero's 50%. Proven this patch: worth copying.

gameFlags.summary: Primal Fangtooth cost 4 allied deaths and 1 structures right after
evidence: 23.9m: Kira died to Steel at the Fangtooth pit
23.9m: Khaimera died to Argus in their jungle
24.0m: Maco died to Legion on the duo lane in our half
24.4m: Scarlett died to Aurora on the offlane in our half
Then they took duo inner tower (24.7m).
9 deaths, the most in the game.
13/6/4, 84346 hero damage, the most in the game.
Hero damage per minute 2109 vs their Gadget norm 1010.

bullets: After Orbital Sanction, Spear Of Desolation added 10% damage for 6s; Malady struck heroes below 40% health, grew per Demise stack, and takedowns reset Malady's cooldown.
Thraex marked the last hero Legion's rifle hit, so Legion dealt more to and took less from that hero; Savage Strikes added on-hit damage that healed Legion.
Rallying Roar added ultimate haste beyond the 33 item ability haste, and an Orbital Sanction cast, when Rallying Roar was ready, sped up Legion and nearby allies.
Hoarfrost roots and Cryoseism stuns set off Vortex Stone when ready, shielding Aurora and cutting current basic ability cooldowns by 20%, so Boreal Sweep and Hoarfrost returned sooner.
Nihil's Doom built power and armor while Aurora kept damaging heroes, and Adaptive Plating added matching armor for each hit taken, up to a cap.
Forticus shielded Aurora on taking hero damage, on a cooldown, and From the Abyss restored health in hero combat or out of enemy vision.
Tesla Dome's repeated hits set off Entropy at most once every 0.2s per target and kept refreshing Megacosm's damage over time on every hero inside.
Xyris's damage bonus grew with units killed, up to a cap; Cull the Weak hit minions and monsters harder, restoring mana on kills; Dominance healed Gadget on takedowns.
Wraith Leggings added 12% ability damage on heroes below 40% health, and takedowns gave Field Data Accumulation 20 stacks toward permanent magical power.

coachLean.headline: Objective control won this: every Fangtooth and Primal Fangtooth, the first Shaper, 10 structures to 6 and 90,525 objective damage to 35,949.

flags.text: Gadget carried the damage: 13 kills and 2,109 hero damage a minute against a Gadget norm of 1,010.
We took Primal Fangtooth, then lost the next fight 1-4 and our duo inner tower right after.
The second Shaper went to the enemy uncontested with all five of us alive.
Scarlett died 9 times, the most in the game: 4 to Aurora and 4 to Legion.

focus.action: After a major take, reset instead of fighting on, contest every Shaper with five alive, and engage only once Hoarfrost, Shield Slam and Rally Point's knockback are spent.

db67dca6-1e03-4bc5-a3de-8aae3a8091a3: Rotated to the duo lane for kills on Legion and Kwang plus the enemy duo outer tower, while our mid outer tower fell on the same trip.
Six deaths, two to Legion and four outside detected kill clusters; next game, bait Rally Point's knockback before trading and step in during Legion's reload.
782e2aa7-e910-4fa1-8298-04e20c12baeb: Four deaths went to Legion late with no physical armor built; next game, buy physical armor once Legion's penetration items land.
Next game, stay out of the Hoarfrost ring while the ring persists, spread so Cryoseism does not chain, and trade once Glacial Charge is down.
Hold Swan Song as the follow-up after Khaimera's Cull catches a target, the pick plan this draft offers.
7c8ab99c-31c5-4ea5-a6fa-e0d6417c3f1b: Ran the vision and the healing: 17 wards against a usual 12.7, 36,434 healing, 33% kill participation and a single death.
Zero wards cleared while the enemy destroyed 9; next game, clear wards around the Shaper pit before spawn so all five can contest.
10edbf65-457d-48d0-9151-9df5b4fcb40a: Closed the game: final kills on Legion and Kwang came right before the last inhibitor and core fell, with 22,491 objective damage and three deaths.
Died to Steel at the Fangtooth pit after the Primal Fangtooth take; next game, wait out Shield Slam and Bull Rush before stepping forward.
a412baf3-dd17-4f89-8ecf-9d0704f3a79e: Led the team with 52,565 objective damage while the team took all three Fangtooth, both Primal Fangtooth and river buffs 25 to 9.
Seven deaths, two each to Kwang, Legion and Argus; next game, throw Cull for a pick only after Shield Slam and Dread Nova are spent.
